articles.title: PayPal expands stablecoin push as crypto assets factor into Q2 results
articles.snippet: PayPal highlighted growth of stablecoins and AI-driven payment tools in Q2 while reporting $8.68 billion in revenue and an $81 million crypto-related earnings adjustment.

articles.title: IMF warns Brazil’s stablecoin activity outpaces traditional capital flows
articles.snippet: The IMF said Brazil’s stablecoin market has expanded rapidly since 2017, with cross-border crypto flows growing faster than traditional capital flows.

articles.title: Samsung Wallet Will Add Stablecoin Support, Including USDC
articles.snippet: Samsung showed a wallet mockup holding Circle's USDC at Galaxy Unpacked. But details are scarce.
